notes.title: Introducing the Changes in the Newest Version of Nigate Tale
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Over the past few months, we have conducted comprehensive code adjustments and optimizations for Nigate Tale’s underlying code. We’ve also made adjustments  to certain values and unreasonable designs. Today, we are finally able to deliver this revamped version to all of you, in hopes of providing a better gaming experience.

This new iteration of Nigate Tale primarily focuses on code optimizations, setting the stage for future content creation. Therefore, this version does not include any new content. Rest assured, though, that we’re committed to enhancing gameplay and introducing brand-new features in the upcoming updates to elevate your gaming experience.

While we’ve conducted several rounds of testing on this revamped version, unforeseen issues may still arise during gameplay sessions. If you encounter any problems, or if you have any feedback or suggestions for the game, please don’t hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/cRQ4U4qwNz]comment it on our Discord server[/url]. We sincerely value your feedback!

Lastly, we would like to express our gratitude for your patience and understanding over the years. We’ll continue to work diligently to meet your expectations.

2P Games

notes.title: New Minor Update Now Available
notes.notes:
Hey there, dear heroes!

Are you doing well these days? Today we come to you again with great news regarding the [b]latest version of [i]Nigate Tale[/i][/b]. A [b]new patch[/b] for our wonderful roguelike adventure is now available, and it comes with a lot of [b]expected fixes[/b]. Check the brief list below to learn more about them:

[list]
[*] Some skills of the Elite Monster Baphomet weren’t dealing the appropriate amount of damage. This bug has been fixed.
[*] A bug in the unlocking process of the Monster Girl Circe has been fixed too.
[*] All marks should be working correctly now. 
[*] This hotfix also prevents some combinations of blessings from failing, as it was happening in the previous version of the build.
[*] Some tarot cards weren’t working as expected. The bug has been fixed.
[*] A lighting error in the Loka Pride scene has been fixed.
[*] Shield collisions in Hard mode should be working correctly now.
[*] Those texts still displayed in Chinese have been translated into English. You should be able to see them now!
[*] The system behind the generation of rewards and the store has been optimized.
[*] The fourth level’s map UX has been improved.
[/list]

[b]Is there any other fix you’re missing this time?[/b] If you found an issue we haven’t noticed, please let us know in the comments section, or via Steam Forums. Also, remember that we’re always checking [url=https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU]2P Games’ community Discord server[/url] — you’re more than invited to join us there!

Have a nice rest of the week,
Hermit Games & 2P Games

notes.title: Version 0.4 is ready for download!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/7c64d106c28745c2824d5f4f223ceb2e812c6d3e.jpg[/img]

Well guys, we made it in time! A few days before the Chinese New Year, and despite all the setbacks we’ve faced, we have managed to release this expected new update of Nigate Tale. Version 0.4 opens the door to a new stage in the history of the game, with many more surprises to come. The whole team expects to be able to tell you more after the national holidays, but for now? Let's enjoy what we have in our hands!

We don't want to unnecessarily extend ourselves by detailing again the content of the major patch (read the patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048350/eventcomments/4792394847116798642]here[/url]), but to thank all of our players one more time for their patience and support since Nigate Tale was launched on Early Access in April 2021.

Both Hermit Games and 2P Games are very happy to count on such a kind and involved community. Also, we would like to send a big "thank you”' to those content creators who enjoyed Nigate Tale in their live streams and videos, for helping us bring the magic of the game to a weirder audience across the globe. You are all essential to our project, and none of us will forget that you have been there when we needed you the most.

We hope to continue counting on all of you from now on, and that this new game patch will make you even more eager to play what's to come. Now, take your swords and head to the castle to smash some goblins! Remember that if you have any doubts or problems or even any feedback that you want to tell us about, we read them both in the comments section and in the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU]2P Games Discord channel[/url].

[h2]NOTES[/h2]

[b]If you were playing v.0.3 before the v.0.4 update[/b]
There’s nothing to worry about, just keep playing as usual! All the objects you collected until then will return to your hand, including the points spent to unlock new skills or the cakes you gave to the monster girls. The best thing about it is that you can try different character builds without starting a new adventure and discover which one fits your play style better.

[b]If you played the beta version before the update[/b]
The game will be resumed at the same point you left it without needing to redistribute the skill points and the presents for monster girls.

[b]Don’t get back to v.0.3 after playing v.0.4 beta version[/b]
Please wait until January 27th before making any changes on your current version of Nigate Tale — otherwise your data will be corrupted.

There’s a small probability that your game file gets corrupted after the new major update, so we strongly recommend you copy them from C:\ Users\（Username）\AppData\Local\Roguelite\Saved to a separate folder.
The save data will be on C:\Users \(your Windows username) \AppData \Local \Roguelite \Saved \SaveGames and copy that folder to somewhere safe! 

Thanks for reading, happy gaming!

notes.title: Major update coming on January 27th!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear heroes!

This is the news we’ve been expecting to announce for the last four months, and it’s finally here after all! The latest [b]major update[/b] for Nigate Tale, which we tested in late December with our current player base, will be [b]available for every Steam user that purchases the game from January 27th onwards[/b]. It’s coming with a bunch of changes you'll identify at first sight, and other not-so-visible upgrades focused on making the game experience smoother and more balanced than before.

In our latest announcement, we already detailed most of the changes that players will find in Nigate Tale after its corresponding patch. Today, you’ll find further information since our team identified several new bugs in the past weeks thanks to your invaluable help via Discord. Let’s begin!

[b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] The visible interface has been completely reworked to look vivid and more cartoonish. We hope you’re a big fan of blue and yellow tones!
[/list]
[b]The sewers[/b]
[list]
[*] The sewers of the castle have been refurbished, taking the form of a larger and cozier circular courtyard. The monster girls will be walking between their own semi-open rooms, built on small elevations around the central corridor, and this new hallway. Their personal spaces will receive new customizations as your relationship with them strengthens.
[*] You can access the wiki from the pause menu, so Mickey the merchant will now trade pieces of cake for cute gifts to get a higher level of friendship with the monster girls.
[*] The weapon upgrade service is now available at Alona’s store.
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] Most of the levels have been redesigned as well to include new special quests and challenges.
[*] You’ll find a wider variety of traps, and a large number of them too.
[*] Players will meet the castle’s owner to challenge him at the end of his level.
[/list]
[b]Monster girls[/b]
[list]
[*] A new monster girl will join your tour team after defeating the lord of the castle. Who might she be?
[*] The friendship system has been reworked. We’re introducing new slots to equip blessing enhancements at the beginning of each run. There are dozens of different choices and combinations!
[*] Unlock new slots by giving the monster girls any of the special gifts sold by Mickey at his stall.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Some enemies’ designs received an important upgrade, and they’re now stronger in Hard Mode.
[/list]
If you feel there's something missing, or you want to share your thoughts on it, please use the comment box below. Have a nice week, and happy gaming!
2P Games

notes.title: NIGATE TALE WILL RECEIVE A MAJOR UPDATE IN DECEMBER
notes.notes:
Greetings!

As the year comes to an end, many of you expect us to share a sneak peek of the anticipated next main update of Nigate Tale. Back in late September, we announced an adjustment of the original roadmap, driven by our players’ feedback -- as well as our own perception and playing experience.

We’ve been working hard to solve the outstanding issues and develop new content, but as it happens often in games development, overcoming a challenge brings new ones, and we think the game needs more time to reach its full potential as our community of gamers deserves. That’s why we have decided to [b]push the next major update to late December 2021[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/9f320c438704d72884a67b21d03f8059fcfe2d8a.jpg[/img]

We’re sad to make this decision, but we hope you understand that we do it only with the best interest of our players in mind. This new deadline will allow us to [b]redesign the user interface[/b] as expected, and also test many other ideas related to the existent and [b]new areas[/b] of the game. Perhaps, you won’t recognize the sewers of the castle after the upcoming patch!

One way or another, we strongly believe this is a worthy sacrifice. You may have a lot of questions about it, so feel free to satisfy your curiosity by asking us whatever you want to know about the status of the game -- or its definitive features. We’ll keep unveiling new information here on Steam and via social media, so make sure to follow our official channels and stay tuned for updates.

Without further ado, here are the new assets we promised we would be showing today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/acabf792b03eeddaf8a48b8738c45a85dbc5eb09.jpg[/img]

See you soon, our dear heroes. Take care and enjoy your week!

Best regards,
Hermit Games & 2P Games

notes.title: Nigate Tale V0.3.02_2401 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We’ve been hard at work developing the next major update of Nigate Tale, and after a long journey, we’re glad to announce that we’re releasing Nigate Tale V.0.3 – featuring our New Monster Girl, Kris, the Electric Ray Girl, the little princess of the Skatians! We’re sure her name rings a bell –keep reading to discover why! On top of that, we have made a few adjustment to Rothschild and her blessing, as well as added 3 brand new Tarot Cards. Here’s full list for our V0.3 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/e6927a2869009007e047c58e8a56adad82130325.png[/img]

[h2]Kris, The Electric Ray Girl, The Little Princess of the Skatians[/h2]

Kris is a little princess of the Skatians, and every creature that lives underwater loves her. She was caught and brought to this place along with her people, only to be treated as seafood. She survived thanks to her people, who protected her, and the mutation that changed everything. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fcfcd99956ed1686fb27cfdc5460be8a2e10f398.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Blessing: Kris have the power of electricity. Kris’ blessings will charge your weapons with electricity, which makes them deal more damage; and every attack can generate lightning orbs. These Orbs bounce between enemies – a great way to wreak havoc upon your adversaries!  
[*] Pet: Kris’ pet form can shoot an orb of lightning that bounces between monsters, dealing damage in her wake. She can also shoot lightning beams!
[*] Ultimate: Kris’ Ultimate Form is the Eye of the Storm! She can generate up to 3 orbs of lightning that will orbit around you, dealing damage to any enemy that get too close to you. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/ed457cbd832cf4a91057a6cfaff2adb1b8f8823c.gif[/img]

As we mentioned, her name and design probably sounds familiar to you, right? That’s because she was the protagonist of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048350/view/3034837093421415311]first dev blog![/url]  

[h2]New Tarot Card[/h2]

With the V0.3 update, we’re introducing 3 extraordinary Tarot Cards into our game that can change the tide of battle for you: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fe5a349ce4bf5c8b9ffd5452fa0bda3c326a6ebd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Upside Down - Sacrifice: You cannot obtain Blessings, but attribute buffs have a 100% bonus (bonus damage, Shield, HP, or Gold).
[*] Tank - Victory: Your Weapons deal 200% more damage, but you also take 100% more damage.
[*] Wheel of Fate - Reincarnation: Increase the level of your Melee/Ranged Blessings by 3, but you can’t use your Support Weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/a78f0c2b03bfc94ca9fbe45947b2f0c2c17176fa.gif[/img]

NOTE: Tanks are actually players or characters who can take a lot of damage. It would make more sense to call it “Cristal Cannon” – something fragile that can deal insane amounts of damage. 

[h2]Update for Rothschild[/h2]

In the past months we’ve realized there were some design flaws in Rothschild. To begin with, as the Kitty Coins are introduced at the very beginning of the game, they can make it pretty much useless. Same goes for the devices – a blessing affecting only one device made them less useful, so we’ve adjusted how that works too. 

Here are the list of changes for Rotshchild in V0.3: 

[list]
[*] Getting more Kitty Coins won’t increase your damage output
[*] You can now increase your damage for all devices with a single blessing
[*] We’ve adjusted the frequency with which you can summon devices – Rothschild is the one who keeps summoning Aircraft and cannons, after all! 
[*] We’ve moved summoning aircraft by rolling to another skill
[*] We’re temporarily removing Summon Storm to improve how it looks – right now it can make the battlefield a mess. 
[/list]


That’s all for today! We hope you like this update – please let us know your thoughts here in the Steam forums, on our Discord server or through our social media channels, we need your feedback to keep improving Nigate Tale! Have a great week!

notes.title: Nigate Tale V0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]1.	Brand New Vigor System[/h2]

Over the past weeks, we have been collecting lots of useful feedback about ranged and melee weapons. In its current version, ranged weapons are overpowered, which makes melee weapons look weak in comparison. To solve this balance problem (especially sensible when you fight elite monsters and bosses), we designed and implemented the Vigor System. Basically, you have to hit them to drop their Vigor, and when it reaches 0 they gain the Broken status. That, in turn, makes them temporarily vulnerable to melee weapons. 

1.	Monsters with Vigor are invulnerable until you empty their Vigor bar, just like if it was a shield 100% effective against all kinds of attacks.
2.	You can reduce monsters' Vigor by using weapons (both ranged and melee) and traps, but melee weapons are the most effective.
3.	When Vigor drops to zero, a monster becomes Broken. A Broken monster cannot move, so it always takes critical damage.
4.	When a monster recovers from its Broken status, it becomes more aggressive for a limited time during which its Vigor cannot be reduced.

[h2]2.	Mutant Monsters are coming![/h2]

In Nigate Tale V0.2, we will also introduce a new category of special enemies: the Mutant Monsters! You will meet these creatures randomly here and there. These are all the kinds of Mutant Monsters you can find: 

1.	Healer: heals nearby enemies by using the Healing Chain Skill (cannot heal themselves).
2.	Volt: creates an Electrified Area that causes damage to the player. 
3.	Binder: creates stun trap areas. 
4.	Glutton: randomly drops bombs or cheese portions, so it can be dangerous but also help you recover some HP!
5.	Cursed: becomes an unbeatable ghost after being defeated. It will attack you until you leave the room.
6.	Ascetic: when this one dies, it will heal all the other monsters in the room to their max HP.
7.	Matrix: summons three conveyors around you, which will teleport you away to different positions on the map.
8.	Echo: summons multiple shadows, but these disappear when you kill the monster.
9.	Runner: runs very, very fast -- no point in trying to run away from it!

[h2]3.	Balance and QoL adjustments [/h2]

[h3]Battle:[/h3]
1.	All weapons: basic damage increased. All weapons have the same 10% Basic Critical Strike Chance now, which triples the basic damage.
2.	Wrench: Fixed a bug that makes Magic Core Whirlwind Combo three times higher damage frequency.
3.	Shotgun: we adjusted the Magic Core Compound Reload from 8 to 4 additional bullets.
4.	Shotgun: we adjust the Magic Core Rapid Reload from 10 to 6 bullets.
5.	Stun: Now, players won't be stunned so often − but some skills still can stun you, so be careful!
6.	Roll: the invulnerability window is longer now (the time which enemies cannot hurt you while you roll)
7.	Weapon: We adjusted the Attacking Anime for Hammer and Sword.

[h3]Blessings:[/h3]

1.	Circe: We dropped the rolling damage for the Shadow.
2.	Mayonna: We adjusted the Freeze damage for Mayonna. Now you can do more damage with her blessing.

[h3]Monsters:[/h3]

1.	Goblin Shield Soldier: HP increased.
2.	Goblin Weeder: Their moving speed is slower now, but they can knock you further than before.
3.	Goblin Butcher: Their Ghost lasts a shorter time now.
4.	Magic Frog: We adjusted their magic, so you can now have more time to dodge.
5.	Cerberus/Demon Dog: After a few changes in their AI, these good bois are smarter now.
6.	Lost Warrior: They're now stronger and faster.
7.	Scarecrow: When a Scarecrow dies, the ghost on the map should disappear.
8.	Deathly Saluter: We made some changes on their Aggro, and we changed the Effect for a better look.
9.	We also adjusted the skill for Lance, Bill, Oggs the Lobster Guard, Albert Beelzebub, Kura the Lifestealer and Baphomet. Please check it out in the game!

[h3]Talents (comparing Before vs After recent changes)[/h3]

1.	Charge: until now, this talent gave you a 10% chance to complete the Recharge immediately (the Cooldown Time is 3 minutes) after using a Monster fatality there was a. Now, after you use your Monster Ultimate attack, you will enter the Critical status and inflict only Critical Strikes for a short period of time (3, 4 or 6 seconds).
2.	Rapid: up until now, this talent reduced the Cooldown Time of your Pet's Ultimate by 10%. Now, defeating enemies charges your Monster Ultimate for an additional amount (in a 2%, 4%, 6%).
3.	Sense: after using a Monster Fatality, there was a 30% chance that the Pet immediately uses its Ultimate attack freely. Now, receiving damage charges your Monster Ultimate (from 1% to 3%).
4.	Modified Defensive Algorithm: every time you receive damage, there was a 2% chance of being immune to this damage. Now when you are attacked by nearby threats, you have a chance (3%, 6% or 9 %) to Dodge the attack.
5.	Modified Assault Algorithm: before, defeating the enemy would sometimes (10%) heal 1 point of HP. Now it increases your damage output (5/10/15 %) when there are no enemies around you.
6.	Legacy of the Forerunner: before, at the end of the game you got 10 additional Monster Crystals for every level you had cleared. Now you get more Gold (10/20/30 %) out of a Gold Bag.
7.	Free Cake becomes Cake of Charisma: when obtaining Monster Crystals, there was a 10% chance of receiving an additional Meteorite Fragment. Now whenever you get a Magic Cake you increase your Max HP (5/10/15).
8.	Free Crystal becomes Meteor of Value: When obtaining Monster Crystals, there was a 10% chance of getting an additional Meteorite Fragment. Now It grants you some Gold (20/40/60) whenever you get a Meteorite Fragment.
9.	After this update, your Talents will be reset -- but we will keep the Monster Crystal you spend and give them back to you.

[h3]Tarot Cards:[/h3]
1.	Moon: before, there was a 30% chance that 0 Energy was consumed when you unleash an Ultimate attack, and the Cooldown Time was 120 seconds. Now, Ultimate attacks are free, but their cooldown time is 300 seconds.
2.	Trail: before, it increased the HP regeneration of any Respawn effect by 100% but reduced max HP by 30%. Now the HP Regeneration of any Respawn effect is increased to 100%, but Max HP is reduced by 20%.

[h3]Pets:[/h3]
Circe: now Summons only 1 Shadow. 

[h3]For Fatality:[/h3]
1.	Circe: Void Plane lasts shorter.
2.	Mayonna: Entangling Touch lasts shorter.

[h3]Levels:[/h3]
1.	We adjusted the maps and made some of them more spacious to make battles more enjoyable.

notes.title: Nigate Tale Day 1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/e730253188e5c9f1ad620ad246c906d7eaf1c2c1.png[/img]

Hey everyone, I'm Totoro, Producer at Hermit Games! We've got a lot to discuss with you today, but before proceeding, let me say something very important to us: thanks a lot for an amazing release day, for your support and for your feedback. After all these months of hard work, and this being our first game, it means the world to us. We're releasing Nigate Tale on Early Access, which means we got a lot of working front of us before the game is ready to move on to full release. We can assure you that we'll work hard, with your feedback guiding us, to bring the best gaming experience to you all. 

Having said that, we want to discuss with you the most pressing issues and development goals in these first days after the release. We are hard at work to improve the performance of the game, and thanks to your feedback we have already identified several problems. Some are fixed, some are identified and we expect to fix them soon. Check the patch notes below for a more comprehensive list. We end this update by explaining the most convenient ways to report bugs or send us your feedback. Stay tuned: in the coming weeks we will reveal the short-term development roadmap and the upcoming content! 

[h2]Hotfixes[/h2]
These bugs are already fixed: 
[list]
[*] Fixed boot problems due to lack of a DLL file 
[*] Modified some short fences in Hell's Kitchen (level 2) to fix weird bullet behavior
[*] Fixed a problem where players of players teleporting out of the door after falling into the water.
[*] Fixed where monsters being unkillable after the robot carrier explodes, resulting in a stuck level.
[*] Fixed a crash that happened after Sin Beetle disappears
[*] Fixed the vampire (Level 3) getting stuck in the organ, resulting in a stuck level.
[*] Fixed bird nests generating unstoppable birds the problem which let bird nest generate unstoppable birds 
[*] Fixed some Translation bugs in English/Japanese Version (thanks for providing feedback in our discord server!)
[/list]

[h2]Identified bugs[/h2]

Bugs that we are aware of and we expect to fix this week: 

[b]1.	Map[/b]
[list]
[*] Some spots in the map where you (or the monsters) can get stuck
[*] After clearing the room, some maps just don’t let you advance
[*] Various bugs around the map that forced you to restart the game 
[/list]

[b]2.	Boss[/b]
[list]
[*] Can’t trigger the Beezlebub/ Envi Boss Fight cutscenes
[*] A skill of Henry the Catfish Angler could get Dorothy’s magical skill stuck 
[/list]

[b]3.	Others:[/b]
[list]
[*] UI error after you edit key bindings
[*] Some hardware equipment could freeze or drop the FPS
[/list]

Apart from these technical problems, we are already working in some gameplay and balancing points thanks to your feedback: 

[b]1.	Difficulty [/b]
[list]
[*] We have already toned down the difficulty of the first and second level (which, based on the feedback we have received from our Closed Beta Group, could be harder than Level 3 at some points). , 
[*] Enemies aggro and attack speed are pretty high in the current version, which makes the melee weapons weaker
[*] In the near future we will keep fine-tuning the difficulty and the attacking to make the experience much smoother.
[/list]


[b]2.	Skill Tree[/b]
[list]
[*] So far, two major points of feedback have been that some skills are too powerful and others are too expensive to unlock  
[*] In the near future, we will start adjusting the skill tree. Overhauling the whole skill tree is not out of the question. 
[/list]

[b]3.	Blessing System[/b]
[list]
[*] One major feedback has been that thedrop rate of different some Blessings make them difficult to control and too luck-dependant. If we keep adding Monster Girls, this problem could grow worse.
[*] We will make players have a better control of the drop rate for each different Blessing, and overall adjust the whole Blessing system
[/list]

4. We plan to improve level and monster designs to make every design stand out even more, so everything in the game looks unique. We are looking for talent, so if you are an artist looking for a job and would be interested in joining our team, we're recruiting!

[h2]How to Report Bugs to us:[/h2]
You can join our Discord server or QQ group for Chinese players -- that’s the most convenient way for you to talk with us directly. 

Here’s the link: 
[list]
[*] Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU]https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU[/url]
[*] QQ group: 127376737
[/list]

If you prefer Twitter or Weibo for Chinese User, you can find us here:
[list]
[*] Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/2pcom]https://twitter.com/2pcom[/url]
[*] Weibo: [url=https://weibo.com/u/7097041154]https://weibo.com/u/7097041154[/url]
[/list]

On top of that, you can always send an email to our team, if you want to or prefer this method. The address is: stevenzeng@2pgames.net

That’s all for now! Thanks a lot for your support, and stay tuned for upcoming announcements about the new content coming to Nigate Tale. Good luck in your adventures!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE IS COMING IN APRIL
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

Thanks for join our Steam Beta Test for pass few months. We appreciate your help, it is you helping us to finished we what need and we're glad to annouce the Beta Test is now close, and we are going to have Early Access in Coming April 12th for $19.99 / €16.99 / £15.99, with a -15% release discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/6e5eb41506a06f47179aa15e02b7f524b73667c6.jpg[/img]

As you might know, Nigate Tale also started recently a new series of dev blogs, aimed at discussing the development process of the game, its inspirations, challenges... The first entry is focused on the main concept artist of the project, a former anime artist, who explains the creative process behind the iconic monster girls of Nigate Tale. We hope you like our story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/1dfe88203e5186d425341a3708e7ef389cb847a4.jpg[/img]

[h2]ABOUT NIGATE TALE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/262797293ee233f0b247af1c71894b49ae18d8f6.png[/img]

After being sucked by a strange cloud, you crash with your airplane in the sewers of an unknown castle. The pieces of your flying transport seem to be lost throughout this place, so the only way to escape goes through exploring it and gather all the components. But it won’t be easy: a lot of monsters, who apparently were courtiers long time ago, will try to stop you! Also, this fortress is trapped in a never-ending day and you’ll be back to the sewers every time you die; the path will change, but your experience and items will remain. The protagonist will become stronger loop after loop! At the time Roy fights his way to escape, he’ll find several allies and discover the secret story of this cursed castle.

[h2]KEY FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Piece up the fragments of a deep and dark story[/b] full of fantasy and magic!
[*] [b]Confront fast-paced rogue-like combats[/b] that will test your game skills and patience.
[*] [b]Design your own battle style[/b] through a wide variety of weapons, magic powers and useful skills.
[*] [b]Befriend cute monster ladies[/b] that will grant you new magical powers and fight by your side -- if you bring them the right presents!
[*] [b]Craft the best equipment[/b] to beat powerful monsters and survive the most deadly traps.
[*] [b]Enjoy a vibrant and colorful world[/b] inspired by isekai series, with astounding low-poly and 2D anime art.
[/list]
